descriptor.label: A2A Agent Card
descriptor.description: Export as an A2A agent-card.json: an agent source keeps its own skills, capabilities, endpoints and auth; a REST or RPC API is reframed as an agent whose skills are its operations.
descriptor.unavailable_reason: A2A Agent Card export needs an agent or at least one operation that is not an event; this source has neither.

skills_from.description: How a REST or RPC source's operations become skills: `operations` (default) writes one skill per operation; `tags` writes one skill per tag, grouping its operations. An agent source keeps its own skills either way.
skills_from.title: Skills From

url.description: The agent endpoint to write as `url` when the source names none (otherwise `https://agent.example.com/a2a` is written and reported). The source's own endpoint wins.
url.title: Url

include_deprecated.description: Also write a skill for each deprecated operation of a REST or RPC source.
include_deprecated.title: Include Deprecated
